NORTHBRIDGE FREIGHT & WAREHOUSING — RATE SCHEDULE (SYNTHETIC, ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY). This schedule applies to shipments tendered under the standard service agreement and is subject to the accessorial charges described below.

LESS-THAN-TRUCKLOAD (LTL) SERVICE. The LTL linehaul rate is $18.50 per cwt, subject to the minimum and fuel surcharge described below. The minimum charge for any LTL shipment is $95, regardless of actual weight or cubic footage. A fuel surcharge of 18 percent is added to the base linehaul charge on all LTL shipments. Dimensional weight for LTL freight is calculated using a divisor of 194, and the greater of actual or dimensional weight is billed. Standard transit time for LTL shipments within the regional lane is 2 business days. Standard transit time for LTL shipments in the long-haul lane is 5 to 7 business days.

FULL TRUCKLOAD (FTL) SERVICE. The truckload linehaul rate is $2.85 per mile for a standard 53-foot dry van. The minimum charge for any truckload shipment is $450 per load. A fuel surcharge of 22 percent is added to the base linehaul charge on all truckload shipments.

EXPEDITED SERVICE. Expedited shipments are guaranteed a transit time of 1 business day from pickup to delivery. A fuel surcharge of 30 percent is added to the base linehaul charge on all expedited shipments, reflecting the priority routing.

DOCK DETENTION. Drivers are allowed a free period of 2 hours for loading or unloading at the dock. After the free period elapses, a detention rate of $65 per hour is charged in 30-minute increments.

WAREHOUSING AND STORAGE. The monthly storage rate is $14 per pallet position, billed on the average daily count for the month. The inbound and outbound handling fee is $6.25 per pallet, charged per touch.

ACCESSORIAL CHARGES. A residential delivery surcharge of $95 applies to any shipment delivered to a residential address.
